title: K-flat chart comparison is natural under augmented chart maps
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M a quasi-coherent O_Y-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], N an O_Y-module, and for every affine open U let MA_U be an A_U=Gamma(Y,U)-module, sM_U:MA_U -> Gamma(U,M) a linear equivalence, and P_U a projective resolution of MA_U. Let K,F be K-flat cochain complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex] of O_Y-modules with quasi-isomorphisms q:K -> M[0], s:F -> N[0] [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Fix n in N, V subset U, and a chain map a:P_U -> Res_phi P_V where phi:A_U -> A_V is restriction. Assume sM_V(pi_V(a_0(x)))=res_M(sM_U(pi_U(x))). Let g_U be the homology comparison from H^{-n}(tilde(P_U extended to nonpositive degrees) tensor N[0] restricted to U), through the common K-flat complex F, to the restriction of Q=H^{-n}(K tensor N[0]); include inverse normalized open-restriction homology in g_U. Let beta be the tensor of the extended sheafification of a with restriction of N[0], and v its induced homology map after inverse exact-restriction homology. Then Res_phi(g_U) followed by restriction of Q equals v followed by g_V.

source.place: Tag 08DX(2), affine derived tensor calculation; Tag 08DV, associated sheaf of a K-flat complex; Tag 06YT, comparison using a common K-flat resolution; Tag 01I9, functorial associated-sheaf pullback. proof.text: Use tensorResolutionChartAugmentation_naturality for the semilinear chart augmentation square. Naturality of tensorResolutionChartRestrictionComplexIso gives the q and s squares.

Apply tensorResolutionComparison_restriction to these three squares, the affine chart K-flatness theorem, and the restricted global K-flat resolutions. This produces the unnormalized chart comparison square.

Use tensorResolutionNormalizedRestrictHomologyIso_naturality and tensorResolutionChartRestriction_total for the normalization square. Compose with its inverse and cancel adjacent inverse isomorphisms using the elementary categorical tensorResolution_normalize_comparison lemma.

proof_origin.place: The original four-square proof, using the protected comparison definition and its explicit equation and restriction-naturality APIs.

theorem tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso_naturality
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (M N : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (MA : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u))
    (sM : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, MA U ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)] M.val.obj (op U.1))
    (P : ∀ U, ProjectiveResolution (MA U))
    (K F : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (q : K ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj M)
    (s : F ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N)
    (hK : CochainComplex.IsKFlatTensor (R := Y.sheaf) K)
    (hF : CochainComplex.IsKFlatTensor (R := Y.sheaf) F)
    (hq : QuasiIso q) (hs : QuasiIso s) (n : ℕ)
    (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
    (a : (P U).complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
        (P V).complex)
    (ha : ∀ x : (P U).complex.X 0,
      sM V ((P V).π.f 0 (a.f 0 x)) =
        M.val.map (homOfLE h).op (sM U ((P U).π.f 0 x))) :
    let φ := Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
    let R := Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Spec.map φ)
    let N0 := (CochainComplex.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj N
    let RU := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.fromSpec).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let RV := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.2.fromSpec).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let EA := tensorResolutionChartComplex U (MA U) (P U)
    let EB := tensorResolutionChartComplex V (MA V) (P V)
    let α := tensorResolutionSemilinearComplexMap φ (.up ℤ)
      ((P U).complex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
      ((P V).complex.extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat)
      (tensorResolutionExtendSemilinear φ.hom ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat
        (P U).complex (P V).complex a)
    let β := tensorResolutionRestrictionTensorMap (Spec.map φ) EA (RU.obj N0)
      EB (RV.obj N0) α (tensorResolutionChartRestrictionComplexIso Y V U h N0).hom
    R.map (tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso Y M N U (MA U) (sM U) (P U)
        K F q s hK hF hq hs (-(n : ℤ)) ≪≫
      (tensorResolutionNormalizedRestrictHomologyIso U.2.fromSpec K N0 (-(n : ℤ))).symm).hom ≫
      (tensorResolutionChartRestrictionIso Y V U h).hom.app
        ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K N0 (curriedTensor Y.Modules)).homology (-(n : ℤ))) =
    (((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor EA (RU.obj N0)
        (curriedTensor (Spec Γ(Y, U.1)).Modules)).sc (-(n : ℤ))).mapHomologyIso R).inv ≫
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap β (-(n : ℤ)) ≫
        (tensorResolutionChartComparisonIso Y M N V (MA V) (sM V) (P V)
            K F q s hK hF hq hs (-(n : ℤ)) ≪≫
          (tensorResolutionNormalizedRestrictHomologyIso V.2.fromSpec K N0 (-(n : ℤ))).symm).hom
